name: 993 intake valve - F1 proxy and titanium variant
description: Non-functional parametric proxy for comparing the envelope and mass of a 993 intake valve with a 49 mm head and 8 mm stem, with a Ti-6Al-4V variant explicitly limited to simulation.

classification.intended_use: Mass simulation, collision preparation and envelope check only

provenance.record_license: All rights reserved (see LICENSE) for code and record; no third-party geometry redistributed

sources.title: FVD - Declared 993 intake valve dimensions
sources.notes: 49 mm head, 8 mm stem and declared mass of 120 g; the exact functional length remains unknown.

sources.title: EOS Titanium Ti64 Grade 5
sources.notes: Data tied to EOS machines, parameter sets, orientations and treatments; no 993 valve validation.

post_processing: heat treatment qualified for the exact process
finish machining of stem, tip, groove and seat
surface treatment and polishing to be engineered

titanium.alloy: Ti-6Al-4V Grade 5 candidate for intake study only
titanium.heat_treatment: to be tied to machine and parameter set; EOS reference recommends stress relief/ductility treatment
titanium.galvanic_isolation: compatibility with guide, seat, retainer and coatings must be reviewed

known_limits: Overall length is a 109 mm hypothesis derived from a 110 mm product envelope.
Keeper groove, seat, margin, neck radius, coating, tolerances and cam/spring dynamics are not defined.
The generated STL is fit-check-only and must never be installed in an engine.
